```{r load se}

 uneroded_se <- read_rds(here('../SDN_Multiomic/uneroded_se.rds'))
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#check
identical(
 t2t_XISTclean_se$NHLBI_id,
 uneroded_se$`Derived from.x`
) TRUE

```

```{r}

hg38_meta <- colData(uneroded_se) %>% as.data.frame() 
hg38_counts <- assays(uneroded_se)[['counts']] #%>% `rownames<-`(rowData(t2t_XISTclean_se)$ID) 



```


```{r make dge list, eval=FALSE}
# created once
if (!exists('hg38_dge')) {
  hg38filter_mmx <- model.matrix(~ poly(Xn,2) + Yn, data = hg38_meta)
  hg38_keep <- filterByExpr(hg38_counts, design =  hg38filter_mmx)
#  t2t_keep <- rowSums(cpm(XISTclean_counts) > 0.1) >= 5
  hg38_dge <- hg38_counts[hg38_keep,] %>% DGEList()
  hg38_dge <- calcNormFactors(hg38_dge)
saveRDS(hg38_dge, 'hg38_dge.rds')
}
#t2t_dge$counts %>% dim() # 21148    82

```

```{r}
if (!exists('hg38_dge')) {
  hg38_dge <- read_rds('hg38_dge.rds')
}

if (!exists('t2t_dge')) {
  t2t_dge <- read_rds('t2t_dge.rds')
}
```


```{r, eval=FALSE}
# created once
hg38_form <- ~ poly(Xn, 2) + Yn + (1|HT_id)
hg38_vobj <- voomWithDreamWeights(hg38_dge, hg38_form, hg38_meta, BPPARAM = SnowParam(4, "SOCK", progressbar = TRUE))
hg38_fit <- variancePartition::dream(hg38_vobj, hg38_form, hg38_meta)
hg38_fit  <- variancePartition::eBayes(hg38_fit)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#saved once
saveRDS(hg38_vobj, here('hg38_vobj.rds'))
saveRDS(hg38_fit, here('hg38_fit.rds'))

```


```{r YCD as factor, eval=FALSE}
#run once
#for excluding the Y-linked linear genes absent in the 2 to 1 contrast
hg38_meta$YCD_F <- as.factor(hg38_meta$Yn) %>% fct_relevel('1')
hg38Yf_form <- ~ poly(Xn, 2) + YCD_F + (1|HT_id)

hg38Yf_vobj <-voomWithDreamWeights(hg38_dge , hg38Yf_form, hg38_meta, BPPARAM = SnowParam(4, "SOCK", progressbar = TRUE))
hg38Yf_fit <- dream(hg38Yf_vobj, hg38Yf_form, hg38_meta)
hg38Yf_fit <- variancePartition::eBayes(hg38Yf_fit)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#run once
saveRDS(hg38Yf_fit, here('hg38Yf_fit.rds'))
```

```{r XCD as factor, eval=FALSE}
#run once #for creating XCD comparisons between linear and quadratic genes #run once

hg38_meta$XCD_F <- as.factor(hg38_meta$Xn) %>% fct_relevel('1')
#hg38_meta$XCD_Fsq <- as.factor(poly(hg38_meta$Xn, 2)[,2]) # rank deficient mx

Xf_form <- ~ XCD_F + YCD_F + (1|HT_id)

Xf_vobj <-voomWithDreamWeights(hg38_dge , Xf_form, hg38_meta, BPPARAM = SnowParam(4, "SOCK", progressbar = TRUE))
Xf_fit <- dream(Xf_vobj, Xf_form, hg38_meta, BPPARAM = SnowParam(4, "SOCK", progressbar = TRUE))
Xf_fit <- variancePartition::eBayes(Xf_fit)

```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#run once
saveRDS(Xf_vobj, here('Xf_vobj.rds'))

saveRDS(Xf_fit, here('Xf_fit.rds'))
```


```{r eval=FALSE}

#run once
if(!exists('hg38_fit')){
  hg38_fit <- readRDS('hg38_fit.rds')
}
if(!exists('hg38Yf_fit')){
hg38Yf_fit <-readRDS('hg38Yf_fit.rds')
}

hg38XCDL_mm <- variancePartition::topTable(hg38_fit, coef = 'poly(Xn, 2)1', number = Inf)
hg38XCDQ_mm <- variancePartition::topTable(hg38_fit, coef = 'poly(Xn, 2)2', number = Inf)
hg38YCD_mm <- variancePartition::topTable(hg38_fit, coef = 'Yn', number = Inf) 
hg38Yf_mm <- variancePartition::topTable(hg38Yf_fit, coef = 'YCD_F2', number = Inf) 


hg38_mm <- list(
  hg38XCDL_mm = hg38XCDL_mm,
  hg38XCDQ_mm = hg38XCDQ_mm,
  hg38YCD_mm = hg38YCD_mm
) %>%
  lapply(function (x){
     mutate(x, 
       sig2to1 = case_when(
         rownames(x) %in% rownames(hg38Yf_mm[hg38Yf_mm$adj.P.Val <= 0.05,])  ~ 'yes',
         rownames(x) %in% rownames(hg38Yf_mm[hg38Yf_mm$adj.P.Val > 0.05,]) ~ 'no',                       ,
         .default = NA)) })

saveRDS(hg38_mm, here('hg38_mm.rds'))
```

```{r}
if(!exists('hg38_mm')) {
hg38_mm <- readRDS('hg38_mm.rds')
}
```

```{r}
if(!exists('t2t_sig')) {
  t2t_sig <-
  t2t_mm %>% 
  lapply(dplyr::filter, adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>% #.$XCDQ_mm %>% nrow() #nrow(YCD_mm) #1935 #XCDL 827 # XCDQ 16
  lapply(rownames_to_column, 'ID') %>%
  lapply(function(x) {
    left_join(
      x, rowData(t2t_XISTclean_se) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(where(~!all(is.na(.x)))),
      by = 'ID')
  })
  
t2t_sig$YCD_mm <- 
  t2t_sig$YCD_mm %>% dplyr::filter(!(chr_loc == 'Y-linked' & sig2to1 == 'no')) # 1,926 YCD after cleaning 
}
```


```{r}
if(!exists('hg38_sig')) {
hg38_sig <-
  hg38_mm %>% 
  lapply(dplyr::filter, adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>% #.$XCDQ_mm %>% nrow() #nrow(YCD_mm) #343 #XCDL 831 # XCDQ 18
  lapply(rownames_to_column, 'gene_id') %>%
  lapply(function(x) {
    left_join(
      x, rowData(uneroded_se) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(where(~!all(is.na(.x)))),
      by = 'gene_id')
  })

hg38_sig$hg38YCD_mm <- 
  hg38_sig$hg38YCD_mm %>% dplyr::filter(!(chr_tag == 'Y_link' & sig2to1 == 'no')) # 331 YCD after cleaning 
}
```


# now the actual benchmark

```{r}
c(
hg38_sig %>% lapply(pull, gene_symbol),
t2t_sig %>% lapply(pull, gene_name)
) %>% ggVennDiagram(force_upset = TRUE, nintersects = 20)
```

```{r}
t2t_hg38_degs <-
  c(hg38_sig %>% lapply(pull, gene_symbol),
    t2t_sig %>% lapply(pull, gene_name)) %>%
  Venn() %>%
  process_region_data() %>%
  unnest(item)
```

```{r}
t2t_hg38_degs %>% pull(name) %>% table()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#run once
t2t_hg38_degs %>% dplyr::filter(name == 'YCD_mm') %>% pull(item) %>% write_lines('t2t_onlyYCD.txt')
```

```{r}
t2t_hg38_degs %>% 
  dplyr::filter(name == 'YCD_mm') %>% 
  left_join(t2t_sig$YCD_mm, join_by('item' == 'gene_name')) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sig2to1 == 'yes')

```

```{r}
t2t_hg38_degs %>% 
  dplyr::filter(name == 'YCD_mm') %>% 
  left_join(t2t_sig$YCD_mm, join_by('item' == 'gene_name')) %>%
  pull(chr_loc) %>% table()
```

norm expression correlatin
```{r}
if (!exists('hg38_dge')) {
hg38_dge <-  readRDS('hg38_dge.rds')
}

if (!exists('t2t_dge')) {
t2t_dge <- readRDS('t2t_dge.rds')
}
```




```{r}
t2t_cpm <- cpm(t2t_dge, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE)
hg38_cpm <- cpm(hg38_dge, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE)
```


```{r}
hg38_sum <- data.frame(hg38_cpm = rowSums(hg38_cpm)) %>% 
  rownames_to_column('gene_id') %>%
  left_join(rowData(uneroded_se) %>% 
              as.data.frame() %>% 
              mutate(gene_id = gene_id, name = gene_symbol, .keep = 'none'),
            by = 'gene_id') %>%
  full_join(data.frame(t2t_cpm = rowSums(t2t_cpm)) %>% rownames_to_column('name'),
            by = 'name')
```


```{r expression correlation}
YCD_t2t_only <- t2t_hg38_degs %>% dplyr::filter(name == 'YCD_mm') %>% pull(item)
#cor.test(hg38_sum$hg38_cpm, hg38_sum$t2t_cpm) #t = 266.31, df = 17259, p-value < 2.2e-16
#.8968151 

hg38_sum %>% 
  mutate(YCD_t2t_only = if_else(name %in% YCD_t2t_only , 'yes', 'no')) %>%
  dplyr::filter(t2t_cpm < 750000 & hg38_cpm < 750000) %>% # RN7SL2 and RN7SL1 noth, COX1 and EEF1A1 hg38 outliers
  left_join(rowRanges(t2t_XISTclean_se) %>% as.data.frame(), join_by('name' == 'gene_name')) %>%
  ggplot(aes(hg38_cpm, t2t_cpm, color = YCD_t2t_only)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_abline(colour = 'lightblue4', lty = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(no = 'grey', yes = 'red')) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', label = 'Pearson = 0.897\np < 2.2e-16', y = 50000, x= 200000 ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,250000), ylim = c(0,250000)) +
#  facet_wrap(~ YCD_t2t_only) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle('Normalized expression of common CHM13v2.0-GRCh38.p14 genes(cpm)')
```

```{r }
# stratify per DS type
all_cpm <- 
hg38_cpm %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column('gene_id') %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = 'names', values_to = 'hg38_cpm') %>%
  left_join(rowData(uneroded_se) %>% as.data.frame(),
            'gene_id') %>%
  
  full_join(
    t2t_cpm %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column('gene_symbol') %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_symbol, names_to = 'names', values_to = 't2t_cpm'),
    c('gene_symbol', 'names')
    ) %>%
  left_join(colData(uneroded_se) %>% as.data.frame(),
            'names')


```


```{r}
all_cpm %>% dplyr::filter(chr_tag == 'Y_link') %>%
  unnest(biotype) %>%
  mutate(cond_label = if_else(t2t_cpm > 222, gene_symbol, '' )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(fct_reorder(karyotype, t2t_cpm), t2t_cpm)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = biotype)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = cond_label)) +
  theme_bw()
```
```{r}
all_cpm %>% 
  dplyr::filter(chr_tag == 'Y_link') %>%
  group_by(karyotype, gene_symbol) %>%
  summarise(t2t_mean = mean(t2t_cpm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  
  mutate(cond_label = if_else(t2t_mean > 50, gene_symbol, '' )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(fct_reorder(karyotype, t2t_mean), t2t_mean)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_text(aes(label = cond_label)) +
  theme_bw()
```
